packet.title: tree-sitter WebAssembly language files in the JavaScript package (book, tests, implementation)

body.p: After 's delayed (a). The owner (2026-10-20): an easy fix; the book, the tests, then the implementation.

item.p: Owns: bindings/javascript (the shim's code language exports, src/linker.ts, src/index.ts's code languages, the test and the language modules' build), the host shim's source_code_languages.

Done when: a section of the JavaScript chapter passes; a Node.js test loads grammars built from the vendored sources with the pinned WASI SDK (one with an external scanner), parses and checks highlights; the size test passes. Done 2026-10-20 (): the module linker and loadCodeLanguage / codeLanguages; javascript/code_languages 12 of 12 (JSON, Python, CSS; refusals); the chapter 5 of 5; sxml.wasm 13,448,586 / 2,420,734 bytes, +7,713 code and data, budget unchanged. Not supported: emscripten's pre-2021 dylink section, needed side modules, scanner imports outside tree-sitter's list.
